name: Smart Media Tools
author: Habib Mosavi

sections.description:
Smart Media Tools is a powerful, user-friendly image editor built directly into your WordPress Media Library. Instead of switching between third-party software or online tools, you can now manage and enhance your images without ever leaving your WordPress dashboard.

This plugin is designed for bloggers, photographers, e-commerce store owners, and site administrators who need a quick and reliable way to prepare images for the web. With an intuitive interface, Smart Media Tools makes editing simple while giving you the flexibility to control image quality and formats.

Key Features

  • Crop – Cut your images to the exact dimensions you need. Choose from different shapes to highlight the most important parts of your photos.
  • Resize – Scale images up or down without distorting them. Perfect for optimizing images for faster load times or for creating thumbnails.
  • Rotate – Quickly fix orientation issues with a single click. Rotate left, right, or flip images vertically and horizontally.
  • Effects – Apply stylish filters and visual effects to give your images a unique look directly from WordPress.
  • Compress – Reduce image file size while maintaining excellent visual quality. Choose the level of compression that works best for your project, from high-quality visuals to lightweight files optimized for speed.
  • Convert – Easily change image formats to suit your needs. Convert PNGs to JPGs, JPGs to WebP, and more — helping you balance quality and performance.
  • More tools coming soon …

Whether you’re preparing product photos for your WooCommerce store, editing blog images, or managing a media-heavy website, Smart Media Tools helps you work smarter, faster, and better.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin have the option to save the edited image as a new file?

Yes, you can save changes to the original image, or save it as a new file with a different name.

I edited the image but don’t see the changes, why?

This may be a caching issue. Try performing a hard reload — press ctrl + f5 on Windows or cmd + shift + R on Mac — to see the updated changes.

Can I revert the edits?

If you save edits to the original file, they cannot be undone. To keep the original image safe, we recommend saving your changes as a new file.

Does compressing the image decreases the quality

Image compression in Smart Media Tools works by adjusting quality. You can manually set the quality level, giving you full control over the balance between file size and image clarity.
